visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dimly lit, dark space where two ushers dressed in black suits and face masks stand formally in front of a pair of large, reflective silver doors. (2) As the ushers pull the heavy doors open, a woman wearing a voluminous, sparkling light-blue princess-style gown and a glittering tiara appears. She is smiling broadly and laughing as she makes her entrance through the doorway. Floating bubbles fill the air around her, illuminated by the bright hall light behind her. (3) The woman in the blue gown poses at the threshold, looking left and right with a jubilant expression while holding the sides of her large skirt. Guests seated at round banquet tables are visible in the foreground, some holding up smartphones to record her entrance. (4) The camera tracks her as she walks further into the ballroom, passing a small white fountain and decorative floral arrangements. She maintains a constant smile, looking around the room. (5) A groom wearing a black tuxedo and bow tie enters the frame to meet her. They hold hands and begin to walk down the aisle together. Photographers with large cameras crouch and move around them to capture different angles. (6) The couple walks past guests who are clapping and cheering. The lighting is focused on them with high-intensity spotlights, creating a cinematic feel. (7) They reach the front of the room, standing before a large projection screen displaying an animated image of a white Disney-style castle. They turn back to face the guests, still smiling and holding hands, as the scene slowly fades.
